responsibility: Implements GCC’s representation of target function ABIs as call-clobber models over hard registers. It initializes predefined ABI descriptors from target hooks, computes full and partial register clobber sets per machine mode, aggregates clobbers across regions containing calls, and resolves the ABI of a function type, function declaration, RTL call insn, or CALL_EXPR, including function-specific refinements such as -fipa-ra register-use information.
same_name_distinction: Implements computation and resolution of function ABI call-clobber information, including initializing predefined ABIs from target hooks, aggregating regional call effects, and deriving ABIs from decls, call insns, and CALL_EXPRs; unlike gcc/function-abi.h, which defines the ABI classes and query surface.
